items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: Now, one of the jobs we had was, Wingie got the chance to put together a big band and work at the Aragon one night and the Trianon the next night

ctx.x: So by that time you should have arrived to some statement. So many incidents with Wingie during that time, I'm not covering them all, I'm covering most of the highlights. But again, I can count more the times that we were out of work than we were working.

Now, one of the jobs we had was, Wingie got the chance to put together a big band and work at the Aragon one night and the Trianon the next night, or vice-versa, I forget which. But King was the big band at one of the places we

were playing opposite. Now, he's got -- Wiggie got Paul Marés besides himself, Floyd O'Brien, I remember that. Either -- I think it was Wettling. And we had every hot musician -- what they called hot -- in that band. No music, it was all head arrangements.
